These pool names are Design Consultants' own: TMC reads "With Design Consultants LLC" only (V14).

steps: 1) Projects > UAT 04 · Consultant Engineer (Ahmed) > Submittals: open UAT04-MAR-01-0001 "SUB-09 Emergency lighting control panel – with you" (Electrical: Ahmed's at once, as Sara covers Mechanical only). 2) Read every Form section, open the Datasheet PDF and the Sample photo. 3) Try to change an answer.

expected: Remarks are optional with Code A. The item closes Approved, Code A, and accepts no more moves. Download PDF appears (SIG-02).

steps: 1) Projects > UAT 07 · Owner Representative (Noura) > Submittals: open UAT07-DAR-01-0001 "SUB-21 Cable schedule – recommended Code A", which Hafiz raised, Ali Submitted and Mohammed recommended at Code A; it waits at your Owner's review, With you. 2) Read Mohammed's Recommendation, then Issue Review Code > Confirm.

expected: Entries read as events (submitted, returned, approved) with the Project; TMC appears by Company name only (V14); no answers_changed or Document upload entries; nothing of TMC's or Beta Build's Drafts (V1).

steps: 1) Projects > UAT 03 · Project Admin (Saeed) > Settings > Workflows: copy the MAR Workflow. 2) Add a Send Back from Consultant Engineer to the Contractor Draft Step; on the Draft Step set After a Send Back to Comment only (and, in a second copy, to Edit the Form). 3) Validate, Publish, bind.

expected: The changes show in UAT 03's Stage set and its List and Kanban columns; another Project (UAT 01, Al Nakheel) is unchanged. Every Member reads the pages; only a Project Admin changes them.

title: Step Age dots count from the current Step

expected: Dots show 1 to 4+ weeks (4+ all red). For the holder's Company they count from the current Step; the other Company counts from when the item reached it. A Draft shows none. No due date appears.

title: Cancel from the raiser's Steps, only until the first Submit
steps: 1) Projects > UAT 01 · Contractor Engineer (Hafiz) > Submittals: open the Draft "WF-16 Draft to cancel" and Cancel; confirm. 2) Open UAT01-MAR-01-0003, back with Hafiz at the Contractor Engineer Step, and Cancel; confirm. 3) Open UAT01-MAR-01-0011, Submitted to Design Consultants, and look for Cancel.

expected: MAR: Manufacturer, Approved supplier (required), Model, Specification section, Description, Items table with total, Datasheet (PDF), Test certificate, Sample photo, Related submittals, Trade, Location, Scopes. steps: 1) Projects > UAT 01 · Contractor Engineer (Hafiz) > Submittals: save a new MAR Draft with each of Manufacturer, Description, Datasheet, Trade, Location empty in turn. 2) Send for Review.
expected: Manufacturer, Description, the Datasheet, Trade and Location are required to leave Draft; a Draft saves with any missing. Each missing field is named and marked.

title: Approved supplier offers the Trade's list only
steps: 1) Projects > UAT 01 · Contractor Engineer (Hafiz) > Submittals > New Submittal > MAR: choose Trade Civil Works and open Approved supplier. 2) Change Trade to Electrical Works.

steps: 1) Projects > UAT 04 · Consultant Engineer (Ahmed) > Submittals: open UAT04-MAR-01-0003 "FRM-08 Sub-distribution boards – the reply Screens". 2) Open Send to Manager and read the pop-up's fields; cancel. 3) Read the Form.
